table.name: torque: spark authority threshold manual
table.description: Spark retard budget before cylinder cut. RPM x requested torque. Internal ECU units (retard accumulator domain). Lower values = cylinder cuts engage sooner (more aggressive protection). Higher values = more spark retard allowed before cutting. The steep drop with RPM means cuts happen faster at high RPM where spark retard is less effective.

table.name: torque: spark retard budget IPS
table.description: Spark retard budget before cylinder cut â€” IPS variant. Same internal units as manual.

table.name: torque: limit factor manual
table.description: Torque AND load limit factor (RPM x load) â€” manual. Stored as (signed_val XOR 0x8000). Effective = (raw ^ 0x8000) / 100, multiplied with coolant limit. This is the primary load-limiting table â€” higher values = more reduction at that RPM/load cell.

table.name: torque: limit factor IPS
table.description: Torque AND load limit factor (RPM x load) â€” IPS. Same encoding as manual variant.

table.name: torque: reduction scaler manual
table.description: Torque reduction scaler â€” manual. Load x torque input â†’ multiplier applied to the 16Ã--16 limit factor table output. Effective multiplier = raw / 100 (0.6Ã-- to 10Ã--). Higher values = more torque reduction. Primary purpose: scales spark retard magnitude by engine load.

table.name: torque: reduction scaler IPS
table.description: Torque reduction scaler â€” IPS. Same function as manual variant.

table.name: torque: friction ECT compensation
table.description: ENGINE FRICTION - ECT compensation (8x8 ECT x torque index). Values negated (~x+1) and added to friction sum. 95 at -30C (cold = high friction), 0 at 80C (warm = no cold friction adder). All columns identical = effectively 1D ECT table. Part of torque_to_load_target friction model: net_torque = gross - friction_sum.

table.name: torque: torque delta comp fast
table.description: Torque delta compensation (fast) by error index. Part of torque_to_load_target. Adjusts load target based on torque error between requested and actual. Axis: [4, 8, 12, 28]. Table values scale the torque error correction. Higher values = more aggressive correction.

table.name: torque: torque delta comp slow
table.description: Torque delta compensation (slow) by error index. Same function as fast comp but applied with different time constant for sustained torque error correction.

table.name: torque: torque to load
table.description: Torque-to-load conversion (Nm â†’ mg/stroke). Indexed by RPM x requested torque. Data = cylinder air mass required.

table.name: torque: temp compensation
table.description: Torque limit temperature compensation

table.name: torque: spark retard from limit
table.description: Spark retard applied when torque limit is active. 8x8 (RPM x torque input). Raw value left-shifted by 1 (x2). Units: degrees/4 (x*2/4 = x/2 degrees). Lower values = less retard, higher = more aggressive torque reduction. This table directly controls how much torque is cut via spark retard.

table.name: torque: throttle pullback
table.description: THROTTLE PULLBACK by RPM x cylinder load. Code computes: reduction = ~raw + 1 (negated). Directly limits TPS request at low RPM/low demand to prevent torque spikes. 14% pullback at idle (36/255), drops to 4% at high RPM (11/255). This is the PRIMARY table that limits how much torque is produced by RPM -- higher values = more aggressive throttle reduction.

table.name: torque: demand scaling factor
table.description: Torque demand scaling factor (RPM x torque/load index). Output scaled by *0x495/0xFF. Feeds into driver demand calculation before the load-to-torque lookup. Higher values = more torque demand for a given pedal input. Acts as a torque request multiplier.

table.name: revlimit: speedbase manual tour
table.description: Base rev limit (manual, tour mode) â€” coolant temp x time from start

table.name: revlimit: speedbase manual sport
table.description: Base rev limit (manual, sport mode)

table.name: revlimit: speedbase IPS tour
table.description: Base rev limit (IPS, tour mode)

table.name: revlimit: speedbase IPS sport
table.description: Base rev limit (IPS, sport mode)

table.name: revlimit: trim per gear
table.description: Rev limit trim per gear (added to base)

table.name: revlimit: cold start RPM envelope
table.description: Cold start rev limit envelope

table.name: fuel: base lambda target
table.description: Lambda trim â€” subtracted from commanded lambda when O2 feedback active. Throttle/load x RPM/25. Raw u16, scaling TBD.

table.name: fuel: base lambda target alt
table.description: Lambda trim alternate â€” used for bank 2 when O2 feedback active

table.name: fuel: warmup enrichment base
table.description: Warmup/cold-start enrichment (coolant x time). Raw u16, scaling TBD.

table.name: fuel: warmup enrichment manual
table.description: Warmup enrichment (manual transmission). Raw u16, scaling TBD.

table.name: fuel: warmup enrichment IPS
table.description: Warmup enrichment (IPS transmission). Raw u16, scaling TBD.

table.name: fuel: coolant enrichment manual
table.description: Coolant temperature enrichment factor (manual). Raw u8, scaling TBD.

table.name: fuel: coolant enrichment IPS
table.description: Coolant temperature enrichment factor (IPS). Raw u8, scaling TBD.

table.name: fuel: power enrichment
table.description: Power enrichment factor at high load. Raw u8, scaling TBD.

table.name: fuel: lambda modifier by RPM
table.description: Lambda modifier by RPM. Raw u8, scaling TBD.

table.name: fuel: transient enrichment
table.description: Tip-in/tip-out transient enrichment. Raw u8, scaling TBD.

table.name: fuel: power enrich factor
table.description: Power enrichment factor by load. 100 = no extra enrichment (stoich + coolant enrichment only). 125 = +25% extra fuel. Multiplier on coolant enrichment. Clamped [50, 200]. Active only when gear is less than cal@0x73 (default=1, neutral only = disabled). Decreases with load because base enrichment already covers high loads.

table.name: fuel: power enrich gear limit
table.description: Max gear for power enrichment. Active when current gear is less than this value. Default=1 (neutral only = effectively disabled). Set to 5 to enable in all forward gears.

table.name: fuel: enrichment by RPM
table.description: Lambda enrichment target by engine speed (RPM/10). Raw values 0-204 feed into slow enrichment accumulation loop. Modulated by enrichment modifier (0x0F6E). Higher = richer target.

table.name: fuel: enrichment modifier
table.description: Enrichment modifier by RPM -- blending weight for slow enrichment filter. Controls how quickly enrichment tracks RPM changes. Higher = faster response.

table.name: fuel: injector flow vs delta-P
table.description: INJECTOR FLOW RATE vs rail-to-manifold delta pressure (mbar). Axis: 2500-7500 mbar (2.5-7.5 bar delta-P, covering high boost to high vacuum). Flow: 5040-10000 mg/s (5.04-10.0 g/s fuel mass flow per injector). Higher delta-P = more fuel flow. Used to compute injector pulse width from desired fuel mass per stroke.

table.name: fuel: injector voltage compensation
table.description: Injector voltage/dead-time compensation by battery voltage (tentative). Values 0-24 (possible us*10 scaling). 24 at low voltage (8V) dropping to 0 at 14V. May be part of injector dead time / opening delay compensation. Axis: 0-18V range scaled to u8.

table.name: fuel: injector dead time offset
table.description: Injector dead time / opening delay by battery voltage (tentative). All zeros in stock calibration = disabled. Can be populated for aftermarket injectors that need voltage-dependent dead time compensation. Axis: 0-18V range scaled to u8.

table.name: fuel: O2 closed loop min load
table.description: Minimum engine load/MAF for O2 closed loop feedback. 0 = closed loop allowed at any load. Increase to disable O2 feedback at very low loads (prevents lean misfire during decel).

table.name: fuel: O2 sensor ready RPM threshold
table.description: O2 sensor readiness RPM thresholds. Sensor warmup counter must exceed (raw * 200) before closed loop engages. All zeros = disabled (closed loop engages based on other conditions only). Indexed by O2 heater state.

table.name: fuel: O2 feedback debounce
table.description: O2 closed loop debounce counter (32-128). Delay before O2 feedback engages after conditions are met. Higher = slower engagement, prevents rapid O2 loop oscillation during transients.

table.name: fuel: lambda correction table
table.description: Lambda correction table (20x20 RPM x lambda index). All values = 200 in stock cal (flat/disabled). Clamped [100, 255]. Added/subtracted from lambda target after other corrections. Can be used for RPM-load-dependent lambda trim.

table.name: fuel: lambda update divider
table.description: Lambda enrichment update rate divider (100). Controls how frequently the slow enrichment loop updates. Higher = slower, smoother lambda transitions. Lower = faster, more responsive.

table.name: cooling: charge air PWM manual
table.description: Charge air cooling PWM duty by charge temp x cylinder load - manual. 0% = cooling off. 100% = max cooling. Increases with charge temp and load to manage intake air temperature.

table.name: cooling: charge air PWM IPS
table.description: Charge air cooling PWM duty by charge temp x cylinder load - IPS. Same as manual. Higher cold-temp values provide extra cooling for transmission protection.

table.name: ignition: base timing manual
table.description: Base ignition timing â€” manual transmission. Type: u8_angle_1/4-10deg (RPM x load)

table.name: ignition: base timing IPS
table.description: Base ignition timing â€” IPS transmission. Type: u8_angle_1/4-10deg (RPM x load)

table.name: ignition: knock safe
table.description: Knock-safe / low-octane timing (floor). Type: u8_angle_1/4-10deg (RPM x load). More retarded â€” min -10.0 deg.

table.name: ignition: MBT modeled
table.description: MBT (Maximum Brake Torque) modeled timing (ceiling). Type: u8_angle_1/4-10deg (RPM x load). More advanced â€” min 3.5 deg.

table.name: ignition: minimum timing
table.description: Absolute minimum ignition timing. Type: u8_angle_1/4-20deg (RPM x load). Hard floor â€” timing is never retarded past this map, regardless of knock or torque reduction.

table.name: ignition: integrator rate A
table.description: Ignition timing integrator rate A â€” degrees per step vs error

table.name: ignition: integrator rate B
table.description: Ignition timing integrator rate B

table.name: ignition: integrator limit
table.description: Ignition timing integrator authority limit by RPM (angle = raw/4 - 10Â°)

table.name: ignition: idle advance
table.description: Idle ignition advance vs coolant temperature (type: u8_angle_1/4-10deg)

table.name: ignition: idle advance alt
table.description: Idle ignition advance alternate map

table.name: ignition: idle advance IPS
table.description: Idle ignition advance for IPS transmission

table.name: ignition: idle advance IPS alt
table.description: Idle ignition advance for IPS alternate

table.name: ignition: coolant compensation A
table.description: Coolant temperature ignition compensation A (type: u8_angle_1/4-32deg)

table.name: ignition: coolant compensation B
table.description: Coolant temperature ignition compensation B

table.name: ignition: coolant compensation C
table.description: Coolant temperature ignition compensation C

table.name: ignition: coolant compensation D
table.description: Coolant temperature ignition compensation D

table.name: ignition: comp TPS
table.description: TPS-based ignition compensation

table.name: ignition: comp RPM
table.description: RPM-based ignition compensation

table.name: ignition: comp spark
table.description: Spark advance component

table.name: ignition: knock retard step
table.description: Knock retard step â€” degrees of retard applied per knock event

table.name: ignition: knock retard decay
table.description: Knock retard decay rate â€” degrees recovered per cycle vs RPM

table.name: ignition: knock retard decay alt
table.description: Knock retard decay alternate â€” degrees recovered per cycle vs RPM

table.name: ignition: IAT/charge temp comp
table.description: Ignition timing compensation by intake air / charge temperature x engine speed. Values are signed (raw - 128): 0 = no correction, negative = retard. 0 correction below 30 C at light load. Up to -9 deg retard at 110 C / high load. Formula: retard = (charge_factor * torque_factor) / 128, where torque_factor comes from table at 0x6514. Enabled when cal switch 0x223 is set (uses modeled_charge_temp instead of ECT-only mode).

table.name: ignition: charge temp comp torque factor
table.description: Torque factor for IAT/charge temp ignition compensation. Indexed by engine speed x torque factor. Multiplied with the charge temp comp table output (0x5FD0) then divided by 128. Higher values = stronger temperature-based retard at high torque/load.

table.name: ignition: ECT comp load factor
table.description: ECT-based ignition compensation - engine speed factor. Values signed (raw - 128). -12 to -16 at mid-high load. Multiplied by ECT multiplier (0x2396) then /128 to get ECT retard amount. Only active when ECT exceeds 95 C.

table.name: ignition: ECT comp multiplier
table.description: ECT multiplier for ignition retard. 0 below 95 C (no ECT-based retard). Ramps from 5% at 95 C to 75% at 119 C. Multiplied with load factor (0x237E) to compute ECT retard amount.

table.name: vvt: intake target
table.description: Intake VVT target angle (RPM x load). Max 43Â° advance. Narrower sport map at 0x40AA.

table.name: vvt: intake target sport
table.description: Intake VVT target â€” sport/active mode (smaller map, more aggressive)

table.name: vvt: exhaust target
table.description: Exhaust VVT target angle (RPM x load). Narrower sport map at 0x4122.

table.name: vvt: exhaust target sport
table.description: Exhaust VVT target â€” sport/active mode (smaller map, more aggressive)

table.name: vvt: intake coolant trim
table.description: Intake VVT angle trim by coolant temperature â€” subtracted from target when cold

table.name: vvt: exhaust coolant trim
table.description: Exhaust VVT angle trim by coolant temperature

table.name: vvt: load compensation manual
table.description: VVT load-based compensation (manual transmission)

table.name: vvt: load compensation IPS
table.description: VVT load-based compensation (IPS transmission)

table.name: knock: window start angle
table.description: Knock detection window start angle (degrees ATDC) by RPM x load

table.name: knock: window length
table.description: Knock detection window length (crank degrees) by RPM x load. Clamped to 0x40-0x80 (16-32 deg)

table.name: pedal: map manual base
table.description: Driver demand map â€” manual base. Translates physical pedal % to driver demand %. No RPM axis: 100% demand = 100% of available torque at current RPM (resolved downstream via torque model).

table.name: pedal: map manual sport
table.description: Driver demand map â€” manual sport. More aggressive translation curve.

table.name: pedal: map IPS base
table.description: Driver demand map â€” IPS base.

table.name: pedal: map IPS sport
table.description: Driver demand map â€” IPS sport.

table.name: sensor: IAT transfer (3-pt ADC->degC)
table.description: IAT sensor transfer function (ADC ch1). 3-point piecewise linear: 0V=-40C, 0.04V=-31C, 0.53V=-15C. STORED INTERLEAVED: bytes at +0,+2,+4 are ADC values; +1,+3,+5 are temperature values (u8_temp_5/8-40c). Do NOT use as contiguous table.

table.name: sensor: load sensor transfer (3-pt ADC->raw)
table.description: Engine load sensor transfer function (ADC ch3). 3-point: 3.37V->158, 4.31V->192, 5.0V->255. Interleaved storage: ADC at +0,+2,+4, values at +1,+3,+5. Used for limp-mode load estimation.

table.name: sensor: ADC ch14 transfer (3-pt ADC->raw)
table.description: ADC ch14 sensor transfer function. 3-point: 3.41V->161, 4.25V->191, 5.0V->255. Interleaved storage. Sensor identity TBD (MAP, fuel pressure, or oil pressure).

table.name: sensor: TPS min threshold
table.description: Minimum TPS voltage threshold (10-bit ADC: 0-1023 = 0-5V). Below this = closed throttle. Used to gate idle control, decel fuel cut, and closed-loop TPS conditions.

table.name: sensor: MAF min threshold
table.description: Minimum MAF sensor reading (raw frequency counts). Below this = MAF sensor fault or engine not running. Used for sensor diagnostic checks.

table.name: ecu: unlock byte 0
table.description: ECU unlock magic byte 0 â€” set to 0x0D as part of 4-byte unlock sequence

table.name: ecu: unlock byte 1
table.description: ECU unlock magic byte 1 â€” set to 0xB8 as part of 4-byte unlock sequence

table.name: ecu: unlock byte 2
table.description: ECU unlock magic byte 2 â€” set to 0x45 as part of 4-byte unlock sequence

table.name: ecu: unlock byte 3
table.description: ECU unlock magic byte 3 â€” set to 0xD4 as part of 4-byte unlock sequence

table.name: ecu: CVN
table.description: Calibration Verification Number (CRC-16 of cal data from 0x20 to end). Must match computed CRC or fault flag is set.

table.name: ecu: ROM ID
table.description: ROM identification string reported via OBD-II Mode $09 (space-padded ASCII)

table.name: fuel: pressure target
table.description: Fuel rail pressure target (mbar). 8 RPM x 5 load. 70 = 3500 mbar, 84 = 4200 mbar. u8_pressure_50mbar. Y axis = first 5 of 8 entries at 0x6180.

table.name: cooling: PWM duty cycle
table.description: Cooling fan/PWM duty cycle by temperature index

table.name: idle: target correction
table.description: Idle target RPM correction factor

table.description: Idle RPM target by coolant temperature (variant B)

Used for torque monitoring and actual torque estimation (PID 0x62). Peak 665 Nm at 6800 RPM x 966 mg/stroke.

table.name: torque: max load by RPM x torque margin
table.description: MAXIMUM ENGINE LOAD (mg/stroke) by RPM x torque margin. Caps the torque-to-load conversion output â€” limits cylinder air mass. 780-1070 mg/stroke. INCREASE to allow more airflow/power. This is the primary load ceiling.

table.description: Engine reference torque -- derated/limp mode. 510 Nm.

table.description: ECT range for torque limit active. Storage: min at 0x43DC=48C, max at 0x43DD=255C (disabled).

table.description: RPM range (raw axis) for torque limit trigger. Outside this = status flag 0x10000 set.

table.description: Torque limit override factor when limits active. 102/255 = 40%. Controls aggressiveness of limit factor table application.

table.description: Fast torque reduction counter init value. 400 counts. Decremented each iteration while torque is actively reduced.

table.name: torque: reduction counter slow
table.description: Slow torque reduction counter init value. 400 counts. Sustained reduction after fast cut.

table.name: torque: limit hold counter
table.description: Torque limit hold duration after trigger clears. 100 counts. Prevents rapid on/off cycling.

table.name: torque: delta limit per cylinder
table.description: Per-cylinder torque delta limit for delta monitor (DTC 0xAC). 24 raw units.

table.description: Torque monitor threshold A -- spark retard above this = cylinder cut bank A. 77 raw.

table.name: torque: monitor threshold B
table.description: Torque monitor threshold B -- spark retard above this = cylinder cut bank B. 255 raw (disabled).

table.name: torque: monitor negative threshold
table.description: Negative torque excursion threshold. Values below -(thresh+1) are clipped. 255 = disabled.

table.name: torque: monitor debounce delta
table.description: Debounce counter for torque delta DTC (0xAC). 4 counts. Fault must persist this many checks.

table.name: torque: monitor debounce spark
table.description: Debounce counter for spark retard DTC (0xAD). 1 count. Fault triggers immediately.

table.name: torque: monitor delta enable
table.description: Torque delta monitor enable mask (bits 0-2). 0x01 = enabled.

table.name: torque: monitor spark enable
table.description: Spark retard monitor enable mask. 0x91 = all features enabled.

table.name: ecu: engine running RPM threshold
table.description: Engine running RPM threshold (600 rpm). RPM must exceed this for ECU to consider engine running.

table.name: ecu: TPS idle threshold
table.description: TPS idle/closed-throttle threshold. 4 raw = ~1.6%.

table.name: cooling: ECT warning threshold
table.description: Coolant temperature warning light threshold (u8_temp_5/8-40c scale).

table.name: cooling: ECT critical threshold
table.description: Coolant temperature critical/overheat threshold. Triggers limp mode.

table.name: cooling: AC disable ECT threshold
table.description: ECT threshold above which AC compressor is disabled (u8_temp_5/8-40c scale).

table.name: fuel: O2 heater enable ECT
table.description: Minimum ECT for O2 sensor heater activation (u8_temp_5/8-40c scale).

table.name: fuel: O2 closed loop enable ECT
table.description: Minimum ECT for closed-loop O2 feedback (u8_temp_5/8-40c scale). Below this = open-loop.

table.name: revlimit: hysteresis
table.description: Rev limiter hysteresis (411 rpm). RPM must drop this far below limit before fuel/spark restored.

table.name: revlimit: torque reduction amount
table.description: Rev limiter torque reduction amount. 153/255 = 60%. How much torque request is cut.

table.name: revlimit: torque reduction rate
table.description: Rev limiter torque reduction rate. 178/255 = 70%. Speed of torque cut application.
